record.summary: Eight-article private member's bill setting a regulatory framework for the development and use of AI. It defines AI and AI operators (providers, distributor-users, importers, distributors) and makes safety, transparency, fairness, accountability and privacy mandatory principles. It requires risk assessment, with special measures for high-risk systems, which must be registered with the relevant supervisory authorities and undergo conformity assessment, empowers those authorities to audit compliance, and sets fines of up to TRY 35 million or 7% of annual turnover for prohibited AI practices, TRY 15 million or 3% for breaches of obligations and TRY 7.5 million or 1.5% for false information.
record.notes: Received by the TBMM Presidency on 24 June 2024 and referred on 25 June 2024 to the Industry, Trade, Energy, Natural Resources, Information and Technology Committee as lead committee and to the Justice Committee as secondary committee, where it remains. The bill would enter into force on publication. It does not define which systems are high-risk, name the supervisory authorities or list the prohibited practices its fines refer to. 'Distributor-user' renders dağıtıcı/kullanıcı, defined as a person who distributes AI systems commercially or uses them in their own activities. A later private member's bill on AI provisions in the Turkish Penal Code and other laws (2/3358) is TR-02.
record.scope_note: Private member's bill that has stayed in committee since June 2024 with no further action; included as an AI-specific bill before the Grand National Assembly.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored: the TBMM bill page (stored 11 Oct 2026 and unchanged when rechecked on 18 Oct 2026) and the bill text PDF from cdn.tbmm.gov.tr (14 pages: cover letter with the referral stamp, general and article-by-article justification, and the eight articles). They confirm the title, number, term and legislative year, receipt date, committee referrals, sponsor and party, the status 'KOMİSYONDA' and the content of the summary. The description of the bill as the first AI bill submitted to the Turkish parliament rests on law-firm commentary and was taken out of the summary. No English translation was found in a web search; the summary renders the Turkish text.

summary.quote: Yapay zeka sistemlerinin geliştirilmesi, kullammı ve dağıtımı sırasında aşağıdaki temel ilkelere uyulması zorunludur:
Yüksek risk içeren yapay zeka sistemleri, ilgili denetim makamlarına kayıt ettirilerek uygunluk değerlendirmesine tabi tutulmalıdır.
Yasaklanan yapay zeka uygulamaları için 35 milyon TL veya yıllık cironun %7'sine kadar para cezası.
Yanlış bilgi sağlanması durumunda 7.5 milyon TL veya yıllık cironun %1,5'ine kadar para cezası.

notes.quote: Dağıtıcı/Kullamcı: Yapay zeka sistemlerini ticari amaçlarla dağıtan veya kendi faaliyetlerinde kullanan gerçek veya tüzel kişileri ifade eder.
Yapay zeka sistemlerinin geliştirilmesi ve kullanımı sırasında risk değerlendirmesi yapılmalı ve yüksek risk içeren sistemler için özel önlemler alınmalıdır.

The bill belongs to the 28th legislative term; bills not taken up lapse only when the term ends, which has not happened. Draft / proposed, legal force Proposed.
